text: {"summary": "Cluster 'edge' shows 2 CRITICAL and 1 HIGH image vulnerabilities (traefik, metrics-server, grafana), 20 MEDIUM vulns, and one failed kubescape control (C-0017, LOW). The only admin binding is cluster-admin to Group system:masters, which looks like a platform default. Trivy PSS passed 17/17 controls. Node and control-plane checks were not performed.", "targets": ["edge"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 15, "failed": 5, "skipped": 6, "score": 80}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 13, "failed": 3, "skipped": 6, "score": 85}], "findings": [{"severity": "CRITICAL", "title": "Critical CVE in Traefik ingress image", "resource": "kube-system/Deployment/traefik", "controls": ["CVE-2026-65600"], "evidence": "trivy k8s reports github.com/traefik/traefik/v3 v3.6.13 with CRITICAL CVE-2026-65600, fixed in 3.6.23 (k3s-managed add-on, but ingress is typically exposed).", "fix": "Upgrade Traefik to 3.6.23 or later, e.g. via the k3s HelmChartConfig image.tag: 3.6.23 or by upgrading k3s."}, {"severity": "CRITICAL", "title": "Critical CVE in metrics-server (grpc)", "resource": "kube-system/Deployment/metrics-server", "controls": ["CVE-2026-33186"], "evidence": "trivy k8s reports google.golang.org/grpc v1.72.0 with CRITICAL CVE-2026-33186, fixed in 1.79.3 (k3s-managed add-on).", "fix": "Upgrade metrics-server/k3s to a release bundling grpc >= 1.79.3."}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "High CVE in Grafana image with no fix available", "resource": "monitoring/Deployment/grafana", "controls": ["CVE-2026-11111"], "evidence": "trivy k8s reports libxyz 2.1 with HIGH CVE-2026-11111; fixed version is 'none'.", "fix": "No fixed version known; track upstream, rebuild on a newer base image when available, and restrict network exposure of Grafana."}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Other medium vulnerabilities", "resource": "edge cluster images", "controls": [], "evidence": "trivy k8s reports 20 MEDIUM vulnerabilities; the digest does not list them individually.", "fix": "Review with: trivy k8s --severity MEDIUM --report all; patch with routine image updates."}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin", "controls": [], "evidence": "rbac_and_argo shows cluster-admin bound to Group system:masters only, which looks like a platform default; no wildcard custom roles are shown.", "fix": "No change needed; keep membership of system:masters restricted and avoid issuing client certificates with that group."}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Mutable container filesystem", "resource": "edge/Deployment/gw", "controls": ["C-0017"], "evidence": "kubescape C-0017 failed on 3 resources, with edge/Deployment/gw as an example; trivy reports 3 LOW misconfigurations.", "fix": "securityContext:\n  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true  # add emptyDir mounts for writable paths"}], "not_checked": [{"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "Other failed NSA/MITRE controls", "reason": "the digest lists only C-0017 although NSA shows 5 failed and MITRE 3 failed"}, {"item": "Repositories", "reason": "no repos were included in the digest"}]}
